attributes.action: STOP ANDY MACNAE MAKING EAST LANCS RAILWAY A MAINLINE RAILWAY!!
attributes.additional_details: Rawtenstall councillor wants to make east Lancashire railway a mainline station again to Manchester.  This can’t happen. There is to much history in the line and to many people who enjoy this line for him to ruin it. We need this to reach the government
attributes.background: I want Andy burnham to listen to young people and old people who love this railway and stop this idea. He wants to make Britain great again. THiS IsNT THE WAY
